title: Assessment of Collection-Service Fees on Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
## Clauses in force

**A.1 Visit status.** A collection-service fee on a Specimen Collection Appointments visit may be assessed only on a visit whose status is collected, cancelled or no-show, as the system record of that visit shows it.

**A.2 One line per fee type.** Each fee type assessed on a visit is one line, and a fee type is assessed at most once per visit.

**A.3 Medicare homebound.** No trip fee is assessed when the patient's homebound status on the visit record is "Medicare homebound certified" and the visit type is one for which no trip fee is assessed for a certified Medicare-homebound patient, because the collection and travel are billed to Medicare.

**A.4 Late-cancellation and no-show fees.** The late-cancellation and no-show fees follow the cancellation rule; a no-show assesses only the no-show fee, never a trip fee.

**A.5 Incomplete and recollection visits.** Nothing is assessed on an incomplete visit where the visit type waives fees on the visit rebooked after an incomplete collection, and nothing on any visit whose purpose is recollection where the visit type waives collection-service fees on recollection visits.

**A.6 Visit types without patient fees.** Patient Service Center, pediatric, timed and facility visit types carry no patient fees.

## Retired clauses — no longer in force

The following former clauses of this policy are **no longer in force**:

- the former clause that on a collected mobile visit the fees are the trip fee for the visit's service zone read from the zone fee schedule;
- the former clause adding the additional-patient fee for each additional household member collected;
- the former clause adding the weekend surcharge when the appointment date is a Saturday or Sunday;
- the former clause that fees are charged to the card on file when the visit type's fee due timing is "at completion".

The trip charge, the household charge and the weekend charge of a collected home visit, and the way open service charges of a home visit are settled, now follow their current bases. The published figures in the collection-service fee schedule remain valid figures.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical visits)

| Visit | Status | Purpose | Fee that may be assessed under these clauses |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Booked | Initial collection | None yet — status is not collected, cancelled or no-show |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | No-show | Initial collection | The no-show fee only — never a trip fee |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Collected | Recollection | None — recollection visits carry no fee |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Incomplete | Initial collection | None |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, patient Medicare homebound certified | Collected | Initial collection | No trip fee |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | Collected | Initial collection | None — no patient fees on this visit type |

superseded_clauses: On a collected mobile visit the fees are: the trip fee for the visit's service zone from trip_fee_by_zone
plus additional_patient_fee for each additional household member collected
plus weekend_surcharge when the appointment date is a Saturday or Sunday
Fees are charged to the card on file when fee_due_timing is at_completion
